significance: A Paadal Petra Sthalam in existence since the 6th century CE and rebuilt by the Pallavas, Cholas and Vijayanagara kings; it is linked to the Lakulisha tradition and houses a Thyagaraja image of lapis lazuli.
story: A Chola king, Mucukunta, is said to have won seven Thyagaraja images from Indra, installed across the Cauvery delta as the Saptha Vidangam shrines whose deities dance in procession.
